# What will uptime monitoring cost for your monitors and check interval, and who is cheapest?

> Type your monitor count, check interval and growth, get every uptime-monitoring plan priced side by side and the monitor count where the cheapest one changes. No account, no upload.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
